user.title: Choose your devices
user.description: Connect one physical thermostat to a reliable external room temperature sensor.

repair_or_setup.title: Restore or set up a thermostat
repair_or_setup.description: Home Assistant found previous Smart Offset Thermostat rooms. Restore one to retain its existing entities and dashboard links, or set up a separate new thermostat.

menu_option_descriptions.repair_select: Reconnect a previous room and reuse its existing entities.
menu_option_descriptions.setup_new: Create a separate thermostat without changing previous rooms.

repair_select.title: Choose a room to restore
repair_select.description: Choose the room you want to reconnect. Its existing entities will be reused.

repair_sources.title: Reconnect {room_name}
repair_sources.description: Select the physical thermostat and room temperature sensor that belong to {room_name}. Check both selections carefully. You will confirm the comfort settings next.

data_description.climate_entity: The heating or cooling thermostat that actually controls the room.
data_description.room_sensor_entity: The external temperature sensor whose value is used as the room temperature.

setup_new.title: Choose devices for a new thermostat
setup_new.description: Set up a separate Smart Offset Thermostat. Previous rooms and their existing entities will not be changed.

comfort.title: Comfort and features
comfort.description: Set your initial comfort target and choose the features you want to use. You can fine-tune everything later in the integration options.

data.pause_on_hvac_off: Pause control while the thermostat is off

reconfigure.title: Change connected devices
reconfigure.description: Select a different physical thermostat or room temperature sensor. Your presets, learned offset and options are preserved.

create_entry.repair_successful: {room_name} was restored successfully. Its existing entities and dashboard links have been retained.

error.entity_not_found: The selected entity is no longer available. Choose another entity.
error.unsupported_climate: Choose a thermostat that supports a single target temperature and Heat or Cool. Range-only Heat/Cool devices are not supported.
error.already_configured: This physical thermostat is already controlled by another Smart Offset Thermostat.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The connected devices were updated successfully.
abort.repair_not_available: This room was already restored or is no longer available. Start setup again to refresh the list.
abort.already_configured: This physical thermostat is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration for this physical thermostat is already in progress.

init.title: Smart Offset Thermostat settings
init.description: Choose the area you want to configure.

menu_option_descriptions.presets: Create, edit or remove room-temperature presets.
menu_option_descriptions.window_boost: Configure open-window protection and boost duration.
menu_option_descriptions.manual: Choose how physical thermostat changes and off mode are handled.
menu_option_descriptions.learning: Tune offset learning and adaptive overheating protection.
menu_option_descriptions.expert: Adjust timing, limits and controller response.

presets.title: Comfort presets
presets.description: Create a new preset or edit an existing one.

menu_option_descriptions.preset_new: Add another target, pause state and thermostat mode.
menu_option_descriptions.preset_select: Change or remove an existing preset.

preset_select.title: Choose a preset
preset_select.description: Select the preset you want to edit or remove.

preset_new.title: Create preset
preset_new.description: Use a short lowercase ID with letters, numbers and underscores, for example `sleep` or `home_office`.

preset_edit.title: Edit {preset_id}
preset_edit.description: Update this preset or enable deletion to remove it. At least one preset must remain.

window_boost.title: Windows and boost
window_boost.description: Open windows apply an energy-saving setpoint after a delay. Boost temporarily requests the strongest regulated output.

manual.title: Manual control
manual.description: Choose how the controller reacts when somebody changes or turns off the physical thermostat.

data.manual_delay_sec: Delay before adopting a manual change
data.pause_on_hvac_off: Pause control while the thermostat is off

learning.title: Learning and overheating
learning.description: Learning adapts the offset over time. Overheating protection can reduce the setpoint further if the room does not cool as expected.

expert.title: Expert settings
expert.description: These values directly affect controller stability and responsiveness. Change them gradually.

error.invalid_preset_id: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores; the first character must be a letter or number.
error.duplicate_preset: A preset with this ID already exists.
error.last_preset: The last preset cannot be deleted.
error.min_max: The minimum thermostat setpoint must be lower than the maximum.
error.step_order: The rounding step must be smaller than or equal to the maximum change per cycle.
